description: This PHP class, EmployeeDependentsController, is part of the OrangeHRM system. It manages the employee dependents view and handles permissions, component setup, and data retrieval for employee dependents within the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentsController
classes.description: Controller managing employee dependents view, permissions, and data preparation within the PIM module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting employee-specific permissions and component data if the employee number is provided.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability verification related to dependents.
